2120: Luk thung songs make me homesick — especially at this time of year.
Luk thung songs make me want to dance — especially when I'm far from home.
Luk thung songs make my mother cry — especially when she's far from home.
2121: This band's new song is so catchy — I've had it stuck in my head all week.
This band's new song is so dull — I skip it every time.
This band's new song is so catchy — even my son knows the words.
2122: The lyrics of this song are really deep — the more I listen, the less I understand.
The lyrics of this poem are really deep — the more I read it, the more I like it.
The lyrics of this song are really deep — the more I listen, the sadder it gets.
2123: In Isan, put on some mor lam — everyone's up dancing in minutes.
In Isan, put on some luk thung — any gathering livens right up.
In Isan, put on some mor lam — the older folk love it especially.
2124: When I watch Western films I like to turn on English subtitles — that way I catch every word.
When I watch Western films I like to turn on Thai subtitles — otherwise I miss half of it.
When I watch Western series I like to turn on Thai subtitles — that way I practise reading at the same time.
2125: Some people prefer the Thai-dubbed version — but I think subtitles are less distracting.
Some people prefer the Thai-dubbed version — and honestly the dubbing is very good.
Some people prefer the subtitled version — but I think the dubbing has more feeling.
2126: Come on — I haven't seen it yet. Don't spoil the ending!
Come on — I haven't finished it yet. Don't tell me who dies!
Come on — I haven't finished it yet. Give me until Sunday!
2127: Action films are a blast — the chases keep you pumped the whole way through.
Action films are a blast — but afterwards they all blur into one for me.
Action films are a bore — the fight scenes go on far too long.
2128: Psychological thrillers need your full attention — pause it and you lose the thread.
Psychological thrillers need your full attention — which is why I save them for the evening.
Psychological thrillers need your patience more than anything — the pace is very slow.
2129: Whenever a western's on, my dad watches it twice over.
Whenever a western's on, my mum leaves the room at once.
Whenever a western's on, my dad falls asleep within minutes.
2130: Sci-fi films love imagining the future — some of it has come true already.
Sci-fi films love imagining the future — though the science is usually nonsense.
Sci-fi films love imagining other worlds — they really get you thinking.
2131: Korean romance series often end sadly — which is exactly why people watch them, funny isn't it.
Korean romance series often end happily — but people expect a twist anyway, that's just how it is.
Korean romance series often end sadly — so people stop watching halfway, that's just how it is.
2132: This detective series has a nicely tangled plot — but the ending gives the whole thing away far too soon.
This detective series has a very simple plot — you work out the culprit in the first episode.
This detective series has a nicely tangled plot — I had to watch the last part twice.
2133: Animated films these days aren't just for kids — the jokes go over children's heads.
Animated films these days cost more than live action — the animation alone takes several years.
Animated films these days aren't just for kids — plenty of adults go on their own.
2134: Fantasy films let us imagine a world with different rules.
Fantasy films let children believe in magic again.
Fantasy films let directors spend enormous budgets.
2135: This documentary really opened my eyes — I finished it, then changed how I shop.
This documentary really bored my wife — she finished it, then went straight to bed.
This documentary really opened my eyes — I finished it, then recommended it to everyone.
2136: Another thing, I prefer reading books to watching films — because you go at your own pace.
Another thing, I prefer watching films to reading books — because it takes far less time.
Another thing, I prefer reading books to watching films — though I rarely find the time.
2137: I'd rather read non-fiction than fiction — because it stays with you longer.
I'd rather read non-fiction than fiction — though my book club disagrees.
I'd rather read non-fiction than watch the news — because you get the whole story.
2138: When you say books are always better than films — I'd say it depends.
When you say books are always better than films — I couldn't agree more.
When you say books are dying out — I don't really agree.
2139: Totally agree — getting it from a book stays with you far longer.
Totally agree — getting it off a screen is much easier.
Totally agree — getting it from a book is richer than hearing it read aloud.

2120.q: When I listen to luk thung songs I then get homesick — especially when I am far from home.
2120.nat: Luk thung songs make me homesick — especially when I'm far from home.

2121.q: The new song of this band is really catchy — I can sing along to it all day.
2121.nat: This band's new song is so catchy — I could sing along to it all day.

2125.q: Some people prefer to watch the Thai-dubbed version — but I think hearing the real voices has more feeling.
2125.nat: Some people prefer the Thai-dubbed version — but I think the original audio has more feeling.

2127.q: Action films are a blast to watch — the fight scenes and explosions are thrilling the whole way through.
2127.nat: Action films are a blast — the fight scenes and explosions keep you pumped the whole way through.

2128.q: Psychological thrillers need your full attention — watch carefully, look away for a second and you can't keep up with the plot.
2128.nat: Psychological thrillers need your full attention — look away for a second and you lose the thread.

2130.q: Sci-fi films love imagining the future — watch them and then you think along with it.
2130.nat: Sci-fi films love imagining the future — they really get you thinking.

2132.q: This detective series has a nicely tangled plot — by the time you find out who the culprit is it's almost the end.
2132.nat: This detective series has a nicely tangled plot — you don't find out who the culprit is till near the end.

2133.q: Animated films these days aren't made only for kids to watch — adults get a lot of life lessons from them too.
2133.nat: Animated films these days aren't just for kids — adults take a lot of life lessons from them too.

2134.q: Fantasy films can take us away from reality for a while.
2134.nat: Fantasy films let us escape reality for a while.

2135.q: This documentary gave us a lot of new perspectives — I finished it, then wanted to go and read up more.
2135.nat: This documentary really opened my eyes — I finished it, then wanted to go and read up more.

2137.q: I think reading non-fiction is better than fiction — because you get knowledge along the way.
2137.nat: I'd rather read non-fiction than fiction — because you learn something along the way.

2139.q: Totally agree — taking it in from a book is richer than watching off a screen.
2139.nat: Totally agree — getting it from a book is richer than off a screen.
